definitions.explanation: Describes cold objects, drinks, or things you can touch. Different from 寒い (samui), which describes cold weather.
Figuratively describes a person who is cold, unfriendly, or indifferent.

examples.japanese: {冷|つめ}たい⟦お{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

examples.english: This water is cold, isn't it?

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{冷|つめ}たい⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Cold beer is delicious in summer.

examples.japanese: ⟦プール→プール：02958_puuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{冷|つめ}たくて、⟦{入|はい}れなかった→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: The pool water was so cold that I couldn't get in.
I was looked at with cold eyes.

examples.japanese: {冷|つめ}たい⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}らないで→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't act so cold toward me.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{店員|てんいん}→店員：00897_tenin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{冷|つめ}たくて、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{行|い}きたくない→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: That clerk was so unfriendly that I don't want to go back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{優|やさ}しかった→優しい：02640_yasashii⟧⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧、⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{冷|つめ}たく⟦なりました→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: She used to be kind, but recently she's become cold.

notes:
{冷|つめ}たい is an i-adjective meaning "cold" for things you can touch, or "cold-hearted" for people.

FORMS:
- Adverb: {冷|つめ}たく
- Noun: {冷|つめ}たさ (coldness)
- Negative: {冷|つめ}たくない
- Past: {冷|つめ}たかった

IMPORTANT DISTINCTION:
- {冷|つめ}たい: cold to touch (objects, drinks, hands)
- ⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧: cold weather/temperature (ambient)

SENSE 1 - PHYSICAL COLD:
- {冷|つめ}たい⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧: cold water
- ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{冷|つめ}たい: hands are cold
- {冷|つめ}たい⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧: cold beer

SENSE 2 - COLD-HEARTED:
- {冷|つめ}たい⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: cold/unfriendly person
- {冷|つめ}たい⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: cold attitude
- {冷|つめ}たい⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧: cold eyes/gaze

OPPOSITES:
- ⟦{温|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧ / ⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧: warm
- ⟦{熱|あつ}い→熱い：09888_atsui⟧: hot
